name: White Tahoe Cookies
summary: **White Tahoe Cookies** is a [[kind:cultivar|cultivar]] created by the grower Kush4Breakfast and released through [[breeder:Archive Seed Bank]]. A three-way cross of [[the-white|The White]], [[tahoe-og|Tahoe OG]], and an unidentified [[gsc|GSC]] cut, it placed 5th at the 2018 Emerald Cup and 20th at the 2017 Emerald Cup. It is grown as an indica-dominant hybrid.
